searchText: Eth o’clock 🤔? My guess is 10 AM EST - wonder if that's correct... I was thinking everyone gets it except me 😄 for the first point, i was worried it would disallow all contract creation, but i see only in the context of the tx, and create and create2 opcodes can still be used so we all good. for the last point, arent the designated address all automatically warm since they are mentioned explicitly? I get it now. i forgot that you can designate in a tx and then access your designation in another. All those points make sense in my view.
